tests.name: Locked V22/V23 rule replication on held-out MS DMT cohort
tests.artifact: V22/V23 locked APC/HLA-II early-treatment monitoring rule definition + fresh MS DMT cohort table (when delivered)
tests.feature_or_comparison: Apply pre-specified bounded APC/HLA-II rule with frozen thresholds to W8 vs baseline samples; primary endpoint = pre-specified responder discrimination AUC
tests.null_or_control: Exact label permutation (>=10000 perms) for AUC null; pre-registered one-sided alpha
tests.status_change_if_positive: V22/V23 promoted from locked candidate to validated primary monitoring rule; project advances to confirmatory write-up
tests.status_change_if_negative: Primary hypothesis falsified; project demoted to exploratory-only and V36 audit features cannot rescue primary status

tests.name: V36 IFN/APC/STAT1 axis permutation re-test with composition/QC covariate adjustment
tests.artifact: V36 W8 on-treatment feature table (n=8-9) with composition and QC covariates
tests.feature_or_comparison: Locked V36 IFN/APC/STAT1 axis score AUC for response, before vs after regressing out composition + QC covariates
tests.null_or_control: Exact label permutation max-AUC null across the 76-feature family; report empirical p for adjusted score
tests.status_change_if_positive: V36 axis survives covariate adjustment and multiplicity; upgrade from exploratory to pre-registerable secondary hypothesis
tests.status_change_if_negative: Confirms V36 W8 axis is confounded/multiplicity-driven; formally retire V36 features as anything beyond descriptive audit

tests.name: Receptor-side delta direction stability audit across MTX/TOF/ADA
tests.artifact: GSE85034 MTX stress-test outputs + TOF compartment tables + ADA table
tests.feature_or_comparison: Sign and magnitude of delta_RECEPTOR effect per drug; test whether a single signed receptor feature generalizes across MTX, TOF, ADA

tests.status_change_if_positive: Receptor-side feature elevated to a pre-specified secondary cross-drug hypothesis to test in MS cohort
tests.status_change_if_negative: Receptor recurrence formally declared direction-unstable and removed from candidate secondary list

tests.name: Out-of-domain null re-test of locked IFN/APC feature on GSE85034
tests.artifact: GSE85034 MTX dataset + locked V36 IFN/APC feature definition
tests.feature_or_comparison: Locked feature AUC (observed 0.60) re-evaluated with exact permutation and bootstrap CI

tests.status_change_if_positive: Locked IFN/APC feature retained as a weak cross-disease audit readout
tests.status_change_if_negative: Locked IFN/APC feature formally declared out-of-domain null; remove from any cross-disease claims

tests.name: Glucocorticoid and delta-STAT1 mediation decomposition for V36 axis
tests.artifact: V36 W8 feature table with glucocorticoid status and delta-STAT1-axis covariate
tests.feature_or_comparison: Compare V36 axis AUC in (a) raw, (b) glucocorticoid-stratified, (c) delta-STAT1 residualized models
tests.null_or_control: Within-stratum permutation null; pre-specify minimum retained AUC drop tolerance (e.g., <=0.1)

tests.name: T vs B compartment readability falsification of V36 axis
tests.artifact: V36 compartment-resolved feature tables (T and B)
tests.feature_or_comparison: Test whether V36 axis direction and rank-order of subjects agree between T and B compartments (Spearman rho, sign concordance)
